name: Cookie Manager – Simple Cookie Consent & Compliance Banner
author: Icegram

sections.description:
Icegram Cookie Manager is Simple Cookie Consent & Compliance Banner.

This Cookie Manager helps you display a fully customizable cookie notice banner to your visitors and easily link to your privacy policy page. This plugin improves transparency about cookie usage, supports GDPR, CCPA, and global privacy notice requirements, and helps you comply with modern data‑privacy standards.

⚡ Why Choose Icegram Cookie Manager?

  • Fast & lightweight – adds minimal code for high performance
  • Easy setup – configure in minutes
  • Custom messages that match your site’s tone
  • Colors & placement customizations to fit any design
  • Privacy policy linking for compliance transparency
  • Fully compatible with modern WordPress versions

Features

  • Simple and easy to set up
  • Customize the cookie information text
  • Customize the “Accept Cookies” button text
  • Option to link to your privacy policy page
  • Fully customizable colors
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin on the Plugins page.
  2. Set your personalized cookie notice text.
  3. Configure additional settings like button text, colors, and privacy policy link.
  4. Save settings and the cookie notice will appear on your site.
